name: mobium
description: Drive Android and iOS apps — native, hybrid and cross-platform, WebViews and mobile browser pages included — on emulators, phones, simulators and iPhones.
long_description: Mobium automates mobile apps for AI agents — native, hybrid, cross-platform and pages in a mobile browser: map the screen, tap, type and swipe by locator, wait for states, answer system dialogs, reach into WebViews, take screenshots and recordings, and set network conditions, location and accessibility settings. It drives Android through UiAutomator2 and iOS through WebDriverAgent, directly, with no Node. It needs the platform's own tools on the machine: Android's platform-tools for Android, Xcode for iOS.
